description: ODC (coverage C): three types that had never been born by job in this lane, in the same module. (1) IMobileEmail -- in ODC the email lives in an IMobileFlow, the same flow type as the screen and the block (IMobileFlow.CreateEmail), and inherits the Theme of that flow: so it goes into the Emails flow, which the fixture keeps with the EmailTheme, and not into MainFlow, which gives FlowThemeTooBigForEmails; it mirrors tests/jobs/email-traditional.json. (2) IPopover -- the widget of the NRWidgets plugin, which is ALREADY BORN complete: the two placeholders TopContent and BottomContent, and inside TopContent a ready trigger (ITextWidget 'More' + IIcon); the job only adds content, never creates the placeholders. (3) ITextMetadata -- tool metadata hanging from an IScreenAggregate, the only real parent (along with the IAggregateNode) in the 363 samples of the corpus; it is born through CreateMetadata<T>(name, managedBy), so args.managedBy is mandatory and Name/ManagedBy are readOnly after creation. The screen ties everything together: the button calls the server action that sends the email, the aggregate feeds the popover, and the metadata travels hanging from the aggregate.

ops.name: WfCovWelcomeEmail
ops._why: 1. the email: in ODC the parent is any IMobileFlow (IMobileFlow.CreateEmail), the SAME type that holds screens and blocks -- there is no flow type of its own for emails as in SS11. But the flow is NOT indifferent: the email inherits the Theme of the flow, and a flow with the app theme (>14KB) immediately gives the warning FlowThemeTooBigForEmails. So it goes into the Emails flow, which the fixture itself keeps with the EmailTheme and where ChangeEmail and ResetPassword already live
Subject is an expression property (IEmail.SetSubject): in the model it appears as an ITextBasedExpression child of the email, not as text
